### Confident Outfit Recommendation: Modern Grunge-Glam Night Out

To nail an edgy yet elevated going-out look, the key is balancing delicate party textures with heavy, structured statement pieces:

1. **The Anchor Dress:** Princess Polly’s **Landon Mini Dress Black** sets a flirty, feminine foundation with its soft pinch bust, dainty ruffled straps, and lace-up back detailing. It hits mid-thigh, keeping the silhouette light and party-ready.
2. **The Edge (Shoes):** Demonia’s iconic **Kera-08 Platform Mary Janes** provide the ultimate bold contrast. The double-strap Mary Jane silhouette paired with the 4.5" chunky platform grounds the delicate dress, infusing an instant 90s/alt-chic aesthetic without overpowering it.
3. **The Outerwear:** Edikted’s **Mori Oversized Faux Leather Jacket in Brown** pulls everything together into an effortless, cool-girl street-style look. The oversized moto-style drape without a hood adds slouchy attitude and warmth, while the rich dark brown faux leather creates a subtle, intentional tonal break against the black monochrome layers beneath.

Hey! I’m putting together an all-black going-out outfit and want to build the look around an anchor dress first so I can see whether everything feels cohesive. 

First, head to Princess Polly and find a black short party dress in size Medium that’s actually available for delivery. Please open the product page to verify both the size and delivery status, and leave that tab open since it's going to anchor the whole look.

Next, browse DemoniaCult to find a pair of black Mary Jane shoes that work with that dress. Make sure size 9 or 9.5 is available on the actual product page, and open the best option in its own tab so I can compare the vibe side by side with the dress tab; please make sure to note exactly which of those sizes is in stock.

After that, go to Edikted and pick a dark brown leather oversized jacket without a hood as the outer layer, opening its actual product page so I can visually confirm it fits the outfit's aesthetic.

Once you’ve checked that all the sizing and stock details line up, just trust your styling instinct and give me one confident outfit recommendation that feels most cohesive on sight. 

At the end, send me a short outfit summary including the product names and links for all three items, the prices for the dress and shoes, and the specific shoe size availability you confirmed on DemoniaCult.
